audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart (Gnar/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Gnar) and content win[] contradict both the packet levelChart (Gnar,Gnar,Gnar,Skill,Urgot,Urgot,Urgot) and the content whys[] prose, which explicitly argues Gnar wins 1-3 and Urgot wins 6 onward.
audit.why: whys[0..2] describe Gnar winning the first three levels outright (ranged autos, level-2 Hyper chunk, kiting a dashless enemy); whys[4..6] describe Urgot's R execute and percent-HP Purge legs winning. The enum sides were left stale.
audit.corrected: Gnar / Gnar / Gnar / Skill / Urgot / Urgot / Urgot, proposed as one atomic chart group across both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes were framed around 'Stridebreaker timing' with no reference to Urgot's actual spike cooldowns or R.
audit.why: Urgot's real spikes are Disdain online (16s at rank 1), level 6 Fear Beyond Death (100/85/70s) and his first bruiser item, which turns Purge's percent-max-HP legs into a grind Mega Gnar loses standing still.
audit.corrected: Phase whys now key to Disdain's 16s, R's 100s and the first-item Purge spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: the full layer never names Urgot's abilities correctly in mechanical terms — 'his W shred', 'his flip'. It also omits that Disdain (E) SHIELDS Urgot, which is the flagged missing interaction.
audit.why: Disdain carries a shield flag: it absorbs the burst window Gnar needs for a Mega Wallop -> GNAR! commit. Purge (W) also slows Urgot himself while channelling, which is the reason kiting works. Both are decisive and neither reached the page.
audit.corrected: Named Echoing Flames/Corrosive Charge/Purge/Disdain/Fear Beyond Death where they carry advice; stated Disdain's shield and Purge's self-slow; added Purge's 490 range as the line not to cross.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers at all.
audit.why: Disdain 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s and Fear Beyond Death 100/85/70s are the two punishable windows.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into the cooldown block.

edits.before: Boomerang + hop kite wins every melee matchup early. Identify how Urgot contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Mini's ranged autos plus one Boomerang win the first trade — Urgot is dashless here and cannot punish the poke or answer back.

edits.before: Rage management is the champion — track your own bar. Only take the trade when Urgot's Disdain is down.
edits.after: Level-2 third Hyper hit plus a Boomerang chunks him; Disdain (E) is 16s and he has no other gap-closer.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Urgot must walk into your range.
edits.after: Boomerang's slow plus Hyper's speed burst kite a dashless Urgot; stay outside Purge's 490 range and he cannot answer.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Disdain's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Form RNG decides this window: full-Rage Mega Wallop wins, but a Mini window into Disdain (E) plus percent-HP legs loses.

edits.before: Mega + R against a wall is the best engage top lane owns. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Urgot's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death suppresses, drags and executes a spell-less Mini Gnar; a 100s ult beats your form window at level 6.

edits.before: Stridebreaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Disdain's cooldown.
edits.after: Purge's percent-max-HP legs out-DPS even Mega bulk in a standstill once his first item lands.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Urgot carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: A tanky Urgot's sustained Purge legs win the confined 1v1; you need teamfights and walls, not a lane standstill.

edits.before: His W shreds you — kite his flip, boomerang-poke. Gnar wins the Disdain cooldown windows.
edits.after: Purge shreds percent-max-HP — kite outside 490, Boomerang-poke. Disdain (E) shields his commit.

edits.before: Kite his flip and poke him down. Track Disdain before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Kite Purge's 490 range and poke him down. Bait Disdain's shield out, then commit — it is 16s at rank 1.

edits.before: Urgot wins by landing Disdain, denying your pattern, and out-trading your engage windows.
edits.after: Urgot wins by landing Disdain into Purge legs and executing Mini Gnar with Fear Beyond Death.

edits.before: His engage. Stay out of range. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Disdain is 16s and shields him — bait it out, then commit in that window.

edits.before: Urgot wastes Disdain (Flip) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Purge slows Urgot himself as it fires — Boomerang and walk out free.

edits.before: That is Urgot's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Purge is 490 range, percent-max-HP — step outside it and half his damage is gone.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Disdain hurls you and shields him — stay behind minions it tramples.

edits.before: Getting caught at zero rage right after Mega ends — that 15-second window is when Gnars die.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death executes below its threshold — never drop low in Mini with Rage spent.

edits.before: Track Urgot's Disdain (Flip): His engage. Stay out of range. When it is down — Boomerang-W + R him.
edits.after: Disdain (E, 16s) hurls you and shields him; Purge slows Urgot himself as it fires — bait E, then Mega Wallop.

edits.before: - Urgot Disdain: matchup-defining — His engage. Stay out of range. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Urgot Disdain (E): 16s at rank 1 — his only gap-closer, and it shields him. Bait it, then commit. - Purge: slows him as it fires. - Fear Beyond Death: 100s, an execute — stay above the threshold.

notes: Level chart was contradictory in three places (full phases, content win[], packet) while the content whys[] prose already matched the packet — flipped both enum sets to the packet chart as one atomic group and rewrote the phase whys to match. Missing interaction 'Disdain absorbs your burst window' is now stated in winCon, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t. Content-layer early/mid/late and spikes were already accurate and named abilities correctly; left untouched. Not verified: whether Gnar's GNAR! knockup can be blocked by Disdain's shield (shield is damage-only per Riot text, but CC interaction is not stated) — left out of all copy.
